instruction: Given a goal and two solutions, identify the correct one.
input:
Goal: To make easy cheat's pizza
Solution 1: Butter a large oven tray. Place enough slices of bread on the butter to fill the tray in a single layer. Dab the bread with a single tablespoon of tomato ketchup and spread across the entire pan with the back of a spoon. Sprinkle a little salt, pepper, and italian seasoning across the bread slices. Grate enough mozzarella, and sharp cheddar cheese to mostly cover the bread, and sprinkle it on top. Preheat the oven to 400C and bake in the oven until the cheese has melted.
Solution 2: Butter a large oven tray. Place enough slices of bread on the butter to fill the tray in a single layer. Dab each slice of bread with a tablespoon of tomato ketchup and spread across the entire slice of bread with the back of a spoon. Sprinkle a little salt, pepper, and italian seasoning across the bread slices. Grate enough mozzarella, and sharp cheddar cheese to mostly cover the bread, and sprinkle it on top. Preheat the oven to 400C and bake in the oven until the cheese has melted.
output: Butter a large oven tray. Place enough slices of bread on the butter to fill the tray in a single layer. Dab each slice of bread with a tablespoon of tomato ketchup and spread across the entire slice of bread with the back of a spoon. Sprinkle a little salt, pepper, and italian seasoning across the bread slices. Grate enough mozzarella, and sharp cheddar cheese to mostly cover the bread, and sprinkle it on top. Preheat the oven to 400C and bake in the oven until the cheese has melted.
